title: How I Saved $58,000 on My Property Taxes | Gloria Watson
description:
🎯 How I Saved $58,000 on My Property Taxes | Step-by-Step Tax Protest Tutorial (Bell CAD Example)
Hi friends, I’m Gloria Watson with People 1st Realty Group — where we proudly put people over profit. 💛

In this video, I’m breaking down how I saved over $58,000 on my own property taxes using a tax protest — and how you can do the same. I walk you through the entire Bell CAD online appeal process, show you how to use real comps to support your case, and share key tips to make your protest stronger.

This isn’t just for Bell County — if you’re in Williamson or Travis County, the steps are almost identical!

📌 What You’ll Learn:
✅ How to run comps to challenge your appraisal
✅ Where to find your PIN and account info to log in
✅ How to file your protest online with Bell CAD
✅ What to include in your protest to support your case
✅ How to check for incorrect square footage
✅ What happens after you file — including your hearing

👩‍💻 Thinking about protesting but not sure where to start?
Let me run a quick free assessment for you. No pressure — just a way to help our community keep more of what we’ve earned!
